root_cause: The post-merge terminalizer recognized only legacy supabase-migration-history parity/canonical obligation IDs. The canonical 591-ledger recovery used the newer supabase-current-production-ledger-parity family, so migration-history-only files fell through to the unknown-runtime branch and failed with UNWIRED_NON_NETLIFY_RUNTIME_READBACK despite verified main containment and production ledger parity.
prevention_rule: Classify the current-production Supabase ledger parity obligation family as supabase_history_parity_recovery only when Candidate-Type is recovery and every non-governance path remains inside the existing migration/history/security-verifier allowlist. Any runtime path remains fail-closed.
